ignorePatterns.comment: The Terraform registry, the Terraform language docs, the OpenMetadata project site and GitHub itself are repeated in every generated doc page; checking hundreds of copies adds no signal and invites rate limiting.
Placeholder hosts in the HCL examples (openmetadata.example.com and friends) are intentionally unresolvable, and 127.0.0.1:8585 is the acceptance server.
The badge URL contains the PROJECT_ID placeholder: it cannot resolve until the project is registered at bestpractices.dev.
